details.biography:
Dan Gamble is a Scotland-based freelance camera and Steadicam operator. He is a recognised Full Member of The Association of Camera Operators, listed as “Camera / Steadicam Operator” with credits dating back to around 2019.

His early film work includes credit as a Second Assistant “A” Camera on major studio productions. Notable credits include Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015), The Man Who Knew Infinity (2016), The Old Guard (2020), and Morbius (2022). Progressing in his career, Dan moved into operating roles: he is credited as a B-Camera operator on Black Widow (2021) and was part of the camera crew for Dolittle (2020). He also served as a staff member in the camera and electrical departments on Deadpool & Wolverine (2024) and The Union (2024) and contributed to Fast X (2023).
details.name: Dan Gamble
